🧠 AI’s Crypto News Brief: Today's market shows strong institutional momentum through massive stablecoin minting and successful tokenized banking trials. While regulatory shifts in the UK offer hope, security concerns around Tether and network exploits remain critical. 💰Circle mints $3B USDC on Solana in past 24 hours Circle's massive $3 billion USDC minting on Solana signals a major institutional shift toward the high-performance network. This liquidity surge highlights growing preference for Solana's efficient DeFi ecosystem over traditional alternatives. Read full story 🚨Liquid Network attacker says they will return most of 4,000 BTC after bug fix The attacker behind the Liquid Network exploit has pledged to return the majority of the 4,000 stolen BTC. The funds will be transferred once a software patch for the underlying vulnerability is fully deployed. See details 🏦Citi, DBS complete first weekend tokenized cross-border deposit on Swift Citi and DBS successfully executed their first tokenized cross-border transaction over a weekend using Swift’s blockchain ledger. This milestone demonstrates the potential for blockchain to enable real-time global banking outside traditional business hours. Read more 🌍CZ’s Kyrgyzstan visit highlights why state backing cannot guarantee a stablecoin exit Changpeng Zhao's visit to Kyrgyzstan underscored the complexities and risks inherent in state-sponsored stablecoin projects. Analysis shows that government backing does not automatically guarantee liquidity or stable exit routes for users. Read full story 🛡️A two-key breach could hand control of $91 billion in USDT to hackers, report finds A new security report warns that a compromise of just two keys could jeopardize $91 billion of Tether's reserves. Despite a recent rating upgrade, experts identify critical on-chain security gaps that require immediate attention. See details 🏛️UK regulator considers easing ban on financial prediction markets The Financial Conduct Authority is exploring the possibility of lifting its ban on financial prediction markets due to rising demand. This move follows the massive popularity of decentralized platforms like Polymarket among British users. Read more 📈Ethereum Price at a Turning Point — Bulls Target $2,800 After Range Breakout Ethereum has reclaimed the $2,500 level as exchange data shows
